# Oakbase

> Oakbase is a context engine and system of action for small and medium-sized professional services firms, with a ready-made legal ontology for law firms. It builds persistent firm memory from authorised work signals and equips each professional role with a purpose-built Operations Agent.

## Product

- [Firm memory](https://oakbase.ai/#platform): Clients, matters, people, documents and commitments connected with their source context. Uncertain relationships are referred to a professional within their workflow.
- [Role-specific agents](https://oakbase.ai/#agents): Administrative skills for trainees, associates, senior associates, partners, administration and finance.
- [Action in your systems](https://oakbase.ai/#operations): Use the Operations Agent from Claude, ChatGPT or Copilot through MCP, with your firm's access and approval rules.
- [FAQs](https://oakbase.ai/#faq): How Oakbase works alongside a CRM, connects information and controls agent actions.
- [Español](https://oakbase.ai/?lang=es): Spanish homepage and localised illustrative examples.
